items:
Check that the circuit breaker is out of service (both primary and secondary 
 circuits isolated).
Make sure that all the circuit breaker parts are at ambient temperature.

Remove the protection cover (2) and the plug (1) from the gas filling value 
 (see fig. 3)

Apply the gas pressure checking device (see fig. 4) to the gas filling value 
 and measure the pressure.

The correct pressure value is 500KPa (absolute value) at an ambient 
 temperature of 20 ْ C.
For different ambient values, use the correction curve shown in fig. 1.

Pressure values between 400 and 500KPa (absolute value at an ambient 
 temperature of 20 ْ C) do not jeopardize the correct operation of the breaker.

Pressure reset must only be carried out if the pressure value drops below 
 400KPa (absolute value).

This limit also corresponds to the operating threshold of the pressure switch 
 (if fitted)

 with pressure reducer as well as pressure checking and adjustment device which 
 must be adjusted to a value of 500KPa (absolute value) ( see curve in fig 1)

A Teflon or stainless steel pipe, of adequate length and complete with the 
 necessary screw type and fast on couplers, must be connected to the out 
 let of the checking and adjustment device (see fig 2) the SF6 gas must comply 
 with requirement indicated in the following paragraph.

Let gas out of the cylinder into the air for at least 20 seconds in order to 
 clear the connection pipe of air pockets.
Insert the fast on coupler in the gas filling by supplying the gas slowly.

At the end of this operation, remount the plug (1) and the sealable protection 
 cover (2) (see fig 3)

new SF6 gas) and any further revisions, as well as with the corresponding 
Italian CEI Standards, Publication nr.410. it must also be remembered that 
impurities will impair the gas characteristics and compromise the functionality

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection check list I2, which must be 
carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sami Mohamed Hasan, tested by eng. Sayed El-Ashry, accepted by general manager 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Gghaffar general director, revised by eng. Tawfik Alabasery 
EDEPCo. inspection & quality control, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Soliman; EDEPCo. general director of admin., financial inspection, and 
supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety
glasses.
The circuit breaker must be isolated completely and
properly earthed from both sides,
DC control power should be disconnected.
Before using a blower to clean the control cabinet or
when cleaning the insulators, wear breathing mask to protect your lung tissues
from the dust particles.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and
send it to the dump.

Checking the Gas Pressure

following procedure is valid for HA1 HA2 circuit breakers only. For HA3 circuit

not required.

 circuits isolated).
Make sure that all the circuit breaker parts are at ambient temperature.
Remove the protection cover (2) and the plug (1) from the gas filling value 
 (see fig. 3)
Apply the gas pressure checking device (see fig. 4) to the gas filling value 
 and measure the pressure.
The correct pressure value is 500KPa (absolute value) at an ambient 
 temperature of 20 ْ C.
For different ambient values, use the correction curve shown in fig. 1.
Pressure values between 400 and 500KPa (absolute value at an ambient 
 temperature of 20 ْ C) do not jeopardize the correct operation of the breaker.
Pressure reset must only be carried out if the pressure value drops below 
 400KPa (absolute value).
This limit also corresponds to the operating threshold of the pressure switch 
 (if fitted)

Filling with Gas
To carry out gas filling, it is necessary to have a SF6 gas cylinder complete 
 with pressure reducer as well as pressure checking and adjustment device which 
 must be adjusted to a value of 500KPa (absolute value) ( see curve in fig 1)
A Teflon or stainless steel pipe, of adequate length and complete with the 
 necessary screw type and fast on couplers, must be connected to the out 
 let of the checking and adjustment device (see fig 2) the SF6 gas must comply 
 with requirement indicated in the following paragraph.
Let gas out of the cylinder into the air for at least 20 seconds in order to 
 clear the connection pipe of air pockets.
Insert the fast on coupler in the gas filling by supplying the gas slowly.
At the end of this operation, remount the plug (1) and the sealable protection 
 cover (2) (see fig 3)
Requirements for 
the SF6 gas
The gas must 
comply with IEC Standards, Publication Nr.376 (Specification and acceptance of 
new SF6 gas) and any further revisions, as well as with the corresponding 
Italian CEI Standards, Publication nr.410. it must also be remembered that 
impurities will impair the gas characteristics and compromise the functionality 
of the circuit breaker.
Lubrication
All the sliding parts subject to friction must be lubricated at the established 
time with 5RX MOLY grease or 
equivalent .
